protocol: IDA-PE gated pipeline (2026-11-03 frozen; amendment requires a new file, never in-place edits)

bootstrap.forbidden: window-level bootstrap in any reported conclusion

gate0.purpose: Does a strictly causal, nested-cross-fitted lifetime prior add value to the PE backbone at all (concat only)?

prior.nested: outer 5-fold engine-level; inner 4-fold cross-fitting inside outer-train; ensemble of 5 seeds -> mu_T=mean, sigma_T=std
prior.causal: staircase: window ending at t consumes the latest cutoff c<=t prediction (c in {50,60,...,200}, c<true_T); NO interpolation to future cutoffs; t<50 -> training-fold median lifetime with flag
prior.scaler: OperatingConditionScaler fit on outer-train only (n_clusters=6 for FD002/FD004, 1 for FD001/FD003)

leakage_tests_required: T1: perturbing sensors after cycle t must not change mu_T(t)
T2: perturbing an outer-val engine's true lifetime must not change any outer-train mu_T/sigma_T
T3: perturbing an outer-val engine's true lifetime must not change that engine's own mu_T
T4: assert for every window that its consumed cutoff <= window end cycle

arms.M0: PE backbone, unchanged (num_layers=1, use_pe=True, use_ema_features=True; 42306 params)
arms.M1: PE + concat(mu_T, sigma_T) via zero-init injection
arms.M1p: PE + phi(tau) encoding (tau = t / mu_T), zero-init injection
arms.M1_shuf: M1 with mu_T permuted across engines (within fold)
arms.M1_const: M1 with constant training-fold median lifetime

criteria.stat: DeltaRMSE(engine-cluster bootstrap 95% CI) M1 vs M0 on FD002
DeltaRMSE M1_shuf vs M1 on FD002
DeltaRMSE M1_const vs M1 on FD002
DeltaRMSE M1 vs M0 on FD001 (guardrail)

gate0.decision_rule: All four must pass to enter Gate 1. On fail: stop, write gate0_report.md (corr(mu_T,T) by cutoff + hgb arm under the new staircase construction), wait for human.
gate0.plan: stage A: 1 seed (101), FD002 all 5 arms x 5 outer folds + FD001 M0/M1 x 5 folds (fast direction check); stage B: on pass, extend to 3 seeds and freeze official numbers
gate0.dev_budget: PE training budget unchanged (epochs<=80, patience 15, window 50, batch 256, lr 1e-3)

gate1.purpose: Consumption mechanism: is tau conditioning better than naive concat, and are internal mechanisms necessary?
arms: H1 (HGB direct RUL, same nested causal features)
H2 (PE/H1 weight avg, weight chosen on inner CV of outer-train)
H3 (PE + H1 RUL prediction as input feature)

criteria.stat: DeltaRMSE M1 or M1p vs H1 on FD002
DeltaRMSE M1 or M1p vs H2 on FD002
DeltaRMSE M1 or M1p vs H3 on FD002

gate1.decision_rule: At least one of M1/M1p must beat H1, H2 and H3. Else: conclusion becomes 'HGB RUL prediction alone suffices' -> analysis paper, no further modules.
gate1.modules_BC: One small zero-init experiment each (<10% params), compared against M1p, with shuffled-tau control; keep only if CI excludes 0.

criteria.stat: Spearman(u, |mu_T - T|) on outer-val, u = sigma_T / mu_T, per subset
criteria.pass: > 0.3 on FD002 (and reported for all subsets)

gate2.decision_rule: Module D (uncertainty safety gate) implemented only if G2.1 passes; otherwise the paper drops the uncertainty-aware contribution claim.
gate2.module_E: Cross-prefix consistency only after B/C or D has stable gains; drop if no clear benefit on RMSE + trajectory stability.

gate3.plan: FD001-FD004 x 5 folds x 3 seeds, identical folds/budget/labels/cap/scaler/checkpoint rule; official test unsealed once at the very end

criteria.stat: pooled engine-cluster DeltaRMSE CI upper < 0; OR at least two subsets with CI excluding 0 and no subset worse than +1.0

criteria.pass: record and drop all positive claims for that subset
